ann.t: Newspaper Publication of Un-audited Financial Result for the Quarter and Six Months Ended September 30 , 2026.

Grandma Trading & Agencies Ltd has informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 14/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve Un-Audited Financial Results of the Company for the Quarter ended 30.09.2026.
